```yaml
name: SWE-Lancer Task Browser for GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'repos/frontier-evals/project/swelancer/all_swelancer_tasks.csv'
      - 'src/scripts/build-swelancer-pages.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.gitignore'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'repos/frontier-evals/project/swelancer/all_swelancer_tasks.csv'
      - 'src/scripts/build-swelancer-pages.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.gitignore'

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bun install

    - name: Update submodules
      run: git submodule update --init repos/frontier-evals

    - name: Build SWE-Lancer pages
      run: bun run build:swelancer-pages

    - name: Upload docs directory as artifact
      uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: docs
        path: docs

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      id: deploy
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        cname: laiso.github.io/ts-bench/swelancer-tasks/
```
